choice.basis: The dashboard is a dual-axis chart. The blue solid-line series (United States) is bound to the left y-axis, and the red dashed-line series (Canada) is bound to the right y-axis. The O/B check for record r2 correctly identifies that the two series use different vertical scales (evidenced by the 2011 values where the US value of 143 is plotted much lower than the Canada value of 37). Because the 2012 data points lack printed numerical labels and the axes are not on a shared scale, the absolute values for 2012 cannot be determined or compared from the visual height of the markers alone.
choice.option_label: Send 2012 country comparison to routine archive
